# Establishment log — popol-vuh-010 (image 0035 from line 30, 0036, 0037, 0038 to its last-but-one line)

Read 2026-11-25 from source/pages/i0035 (from line 30, after `… cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque.`), all of i0036 and
i0037, and i0038 to its second-last line, in strips of about five lines at 0.9×, with 2–2.5× crops of every
doubtful word, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 21921–22140, 22300–22320, 22440–22510).
Start: `Catecut qui petic zamahel rumal Huncame, Vvcub Came …` (0035 l.30). End: `… quia molah chi tihobal.`
(0038, second-last line). popol-vuh-011 begins on that same line with `Are v nabe ri` (MS `arevnabe ri`),
continuing on 0039 `Queꜫuma ha, vtuquel queꜫum vpam …` — the list of the houses of trial. Image 0039 was not
needed except to place the break (Brasseur's text for it was used).

Content: the owl messengers (Chabi Tucur, Huracan Tucur, Caquix Tucur, Holom Tucur) summon Hunhunahpu and
Vvcub Hunahpu to play ball in Xibalba; the brothers take leave of their mother, hang their ball in the roof
and charge Hunbaꜩ and Hunchouen; the descent: the river gorges Nuzivan Cul / Cuzivan, the river among
calabash trees, the river of blood, the river of water; the four roads (red, black, white, yellow), the black
road speaks; the effigy and the carved wooden figure greeted as Huncame and Vvcub Came; the burning bench; the
House of Darkness, the torch and the cigar that must be returned whole; they are consumed: "they were defeated".

## Folios
Counting as 004–009 did (0035 = 13r): 0036 = 13v, 0037 = 14r, 0038 = 14v → `fols. 13r–14v`. The crops of 0036
and 0038 carry 13 and 14 at the top left (again consistent with the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md, 2026-11-24);
the earlier count is kept.

## Letter rule used (002–009's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ: `cuꜭ` ×5 (B. cuq / кuq), `ruꜭ` ×3 (B. ruq), `ꜭo vxic` ×2 (B. qo), `ꜭolic`, `ha ꜭohul`
  (B. qo hul); gh → ꜭh: `quix ꜭha` ×3, `que ꜭha` ×8, `xe vꜭhaxic`/`xe vꜭhax` ×6, `xeꜭha` ×7, `xꜭhau` ×2,
  `xeꜭhau`, `chuꜭhaxic`, `ca ꜭha`, `xeꜭhacovic` (B. x-e chacouic; MS `xeghacovic`, clear g), and
  `xe ꜭhacatah vi` (0037 l.31, MS `xeghacatah vi`, B. chakatah) — this one instance is written with gh where
  the four others are `chacatah(ic)` with plain ch; printed as written, doubtful.
- q-shaped `qux` → `ꜭux` (009's rule): `iꜭux` (0036 last line), `chi qui ꜭux` ×2.
- tresillo → ꜫ: `caꜫ rih` (B. gag), `ꜫaꜫa be` (B. caka), `ꜫana be` (B. gana), `Queꜫuma Ha` ×2 (B. Gekuma),
  `queꜫum` ×2 (B. gekum).
- plain c / qu kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `queca be` ×2 (B. geka), `Ahalcana` (MS clearly plain c,
  where 009 printed Ahalꜫana with the tresillo; B. Ahalgana), `qui quic`, `ca quic` (B. quiq), `xqui quihila`
  (B. gihila), `qui cam`/`xqui cam` (B. qam), `xchi canah cu cana` (B. gana), `Cuchumaquic`, `Xiquiripat`,
  `quzquz` (B. guzguz), `ca camaihah` (B. ka maihah), `xcucah` (B. x-c'uqah), `quiquib`, `baquib` (B. quiqib,
  bakib), `xqui quiz` (B. qiz), `izic` (B. y ziq), `qui zic` (B. ziq).
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `quiꜩih` ×4, `ꜩih` ×2, `vꜩih`, `Xꜩac`, `queꜩabal` ×2;
  `ꜩe` ×4, `xe ꜩeen` ×2, `vcumaꜩ`, `quix ꜩuan`, `ꜩihom`, `ꜩihon`, `qui ꜩiha`, `Ꜩaꜩ`, `Hunbaꜩ`, `Vꜩ` ×2.
- z (ʒ-shaped, not the ligature) kept as z: `zamahel` throughout, `choconizan` and `choconizah` (B. chokonizan),
  `quix ziban oc` (B. OCR `triban`; the word is presumably tz'ib' 'write/paint', but the letter is the plain z
  here), `xqui zac cut qui ꜩih` (0036; B. zak) against `Xꜩac qui ꜩih` four lines on (ligature) — both as written.

## Doubtful readings and decisions against Brasseur
- 0035 l.32 `he itaca` (MS `heitaca`; B. `he y taka`): the i taken as the 2pl prefix and joined to the verb
  (as `ivaba`, `ivumal`).
- 0035 l.32 `ix rahpop achih` (MS `ixrahpopachih`): divided; title in lower case like `ahau`.
- 0035 l.36 a blot after `cuq` at the line end; nothing read in it.
- 0035 l.37 `Quiꜩih ca ca maihah` (MS `qui|ꜩih cacamaihah`): divided with Brasseur (`ca ka maihah`).
- 0036 l.1 `ri qui quic`: the letters are crowded (`quiquiqque`); read `quic` as 009 and as the clear
  `ca quic` on 0036 l.36. Doubtful.
- 0036 l.15 `Que calem ta xe pe cut` (MS `quecalem taxepecut`): the third letter is a tall looped l; Brasseur's
  OCR is garbled here (`qu TIMES Ta x-e pe cut`). Doubtful; meaning to be checked by the drafter.
- 0036 l.25 `Ahalpuh` (B. Ahalpuh), `Ahalcana` plain c (see above).
- 0036 l.33 `coh iuoiobeh na` (MS `cohiuoiobeh`; B. `koh vv'oyobeh`): printed with u and i as written.
- 0036 l.36 `xa et culic` (B. `xaet k'ulic`).
- 0036 last line / 0037 l.1 `iꜭux ivatit` (B. `u qux vv'atit`): MS has i- in both words.
- 0037 l.4 `mi xbizonic` (MS `mi|xbizonic`; B. `m'vx bizonic`).
- 0037 l.10 `chu chi hal ha zivanub` (B. `chu chi hal-hàc zivanub`); `Nuzivan Cul, Cuzivan` as names (MS
  `nuzivan cul, cuzivan`).
- 0037 l.16 `chi a, chi quiqui a` (MS `chi a | chi qui qui a`; B. `chi u chi quiqi a`): the first word is a, not
  u; `quiqui` joined as one word. Doubtful.
- 0037 l.21 `ꜫaꜫa be`: two tresillos (`ɛaɛa`); Brasseur `caka`.
- 0037 l.25 `In quinicamo, in vbe ahau` (B. `In quin y qamo, in u be ahau`): the second `in` has a tail and
  could be read `ir`; taken as `in` with Brasseur. `quinicamo` printed as one word.
- 0037 l.32 `xqui taqueh` (B. takeh).
- 0037 l.36 `aham che` (MS `ahamche` ×2): divided as the house table.
- 0038 l.1 `vvach` (MS `vvach`; B. `a vach`): printed as written.
- 0038 l.10 a blotted letter between `chi ꜩe` and `xvinaquiriheic`; nothing read in it.
- 0038 l.13 `Xa hix chi ha; ve chi be yaoc ichah, izic` (MS `xahixchiha, vechibe yaoc ichah izic`).
- 0038 l.17 `Ta xqui cam cut` — **abbreviation expanded**: the MS writes `xq̄cam` (x, q with a stroke); printed
  `xqui cam`, as Brasseur (`x-qui qam`).
- 0038 l.22 `xa coloquic cha` (MS `xacolo|quic cha`), `Zaquitoc` (B. zakitok); `xa hucul` (B. hakul — the MS
  has u, doubtful), `xa huzuc` (B. hazuk; MS u).
- 0038 l.33 `e qui ꜩiha` (MS `equiꜩiha`; B. `e qui tziha`).
- 0038 l.34 `chi zaquiric` (MS `chiçaquiric`: a z/c with a cedilla-like tail, as in 006 and 009; read z with
  Brasseur `zakiric`).
- 0038 l.34 `maui chi quizic` (MS `chiquizic`; B. `chi qiziq`); taken as quiz 'finish', the verb of the next
  sentence.
- 0038 l.37 `xha yao chique` (B. `x-ha yao`): the letters are x h a; printed as written. Doubtful.
- 0038 l.38 `vtihobal`, `chi tihobal`: written with a t-i ligature that resembles ꜩh (`vꜩhobal`); read
  `tihobal` with Brasseur (`tihobal`, 'trial').
- 0038 l.38 `quia molah` (MS `quia|molah`), as Brasseur.

`qui pachcab`, `vholom`, `rahpop achihab`, `xe pe cut`, `xe vlic`, `cu tacal`, `chuvi hom`, `Nim Xob Carchah`,
`xqui zac cut`, `achbilai ive`, `ca pixabah can na ca chuch`, `chi cochoch`, `xcaminac oc`, `qui xima can oc
pu vi`, `quix ꜩuan oc`, `xe cah cut pu beal`, `vchi cumuc`, `chupan halhal ha zimah`, `xe chacatah vi`,
`pa cahib xalcat be`, `pa qui popobal`, `xe humuhub`, `que humin`, `chi qui ꜭux`, `xe ꜩeen na`, `mix ix vlic`,
`chi caza vvach`, `xe cat chicut`, `xcat qui culibal`, `xe pichicharic`, `chi qui quiquib`, `xe oponic pa`,
`que ca puzu`, `huzu huzu`, `chi quibil quib`, `yohyox bac`, `chocochoh chi vloc`, `chul qui ya`,
`chul qui moloba`. Catecut, chicut, Quehecut one word, `Are cut`, `chiri cut` two, as 009.

## Paragraphs
Ximénez's paragraphs at 0035 l.30 (Catecut qui petic) and 0037 l.6 (Cate puch ta xe bec); otherwise
continuous. Cut at narrative joints (18 paragraphs).

## Supralinear words
None. One abbreviation expanded (`xq̄cam` → `xqui cam`).
